reason: The null result is robust. Adding the omitted pre-period covariates, or dropping the 1% trim, gives about -0.28 (p≈0.24–0.25). The remote_share coefficient is also uncorrelated with those covariates. The analyst correctly left out the post-treatment collab_index. The confidence interval is narrow relative to an outcome mean of about 100, so 'no detectable effect' is supported.
